scope: OntoSPK-local review; preserve all boundary treatments and private-repository hold.

sources.use: Identity-provider and rigid-type structural comparison; not an imported ontology.
Bearer dependence/characterization and the displayed Abstract=True profile discrepancy.
Conceptual comparison of objects, intrinsic modes, events and participation. No gUFO import or full UFO-B claim.

decisions.title: Product lineage and version baseline
decisions.assessment: Keep authored mandate/product lineage and an immutable approved version baseline as three distinct referents. Rename, ownership transfer and version succession do not by themselves create another Product. Version equality is a declared/canonical-identifier assumption in the transition policy; no content-based or OWL-key identity proof is inferred.
decisions.limit: Semantic identity needs provenance and human/domain evidence; equality of record IDs is insufficient.

decisions.title: Authored specifications and records
decisions.assessment: Retain the current authored-artifact reading and each published constitutive purpose/baseline criterion. Plans, offerings and decision records are distinct from realized behavior, publication acts and physical file copies. Bundle and portfolio references alone do not prove real-world parthood.
decisions.limit: These are existing scoped design choices, not independently validated universal identity criteria.

decisions.title: Stage definitions and status assertions
decisions.assessment: Retain stage-definition artifacts and dated status-assertion records. Neither current class is a Product phase or an intrinsic quality merely because its label concerns a stage/status.
decisions.limit: A real phase partition or quality model would require a separate versioned conceptual decision.

decisions.title: Dependency and user-role specifications
decisions.assessment: Retain specifications of a dependency condition or participation purpose; do not turn their current instances into actual relators or anti-rigid user roles.
decisions.limit: Actual participants, truthmakers and necessary dependence need evidence before a different ontological reading.

decisions.title: Intended ability, concrete realization and actual mode
decisions.assessment: Preserve the intended-ability specification, concrete configured realization and actual intrinsic disposition as distinct. A realization has one version and at least one actual capability; an actual capability has exactly one bearer. Continuity evidence governs reuse of realization/capability identifiers in the separate bounded policy.
decisions.limit: Causal continuity and disposition persistence remain supplied evidence. The concrete Mode abstractness/profile discrepancy is tracked in #48; no strict profile conformance is claimed.

decisions.title: Constitutive condition facets
decisions.assessment: Retain rigid, authored facets under the published ConditionSpecification/RequirementSpecification identity providers. Desired, expected, required and acceptance content belongs to that authored baseline. A requirement statement is distinct from the actual behavior or the agent intention.
decisions.limit: Content essentiality is a model assumption; the review does not impose new disjointness, coverage or modal axioms.

decisions.title: Scenario and test-procedure artifacts
decisions.assessment: Retain authored scenario/procedure facets inheriting ScenarioSpecification identity. Repeating a TestCase is another TestExecution; a scenario description is distinct from an obtaining situation.
decisions.limit: No identity inference from equal procedure text or from equal execution inputs is introduced.

decisions.title: Identity of local reference records
decisions.assessment: Retain ExternalReferenceRecord inheritance and the constitutive local reference purpose. Distinguish reference-record identity from externally governed target identity.
decisions.limit: Owner semantics, replacement concepts and new mappings remain deferred; existing boundary treatment is unchanged.

decisions.title: Outcome records and evidence attributions
decisions.assessment: Retain one consolidated result record for one concluded attempt. An evidence attribution is distinct from its carrier. Verification/validation are constitutive purposes of an attribution baseline; this review introduces no exclusive partition between them. Later reporting time does not imply creation during the attempt.
decisions.limit: Record identity, real outcome truth and independent evidential acceptance are different questions.

decisions.title: Attempt occurrence, participation and reporting
decisions.assessment: Retain the concluded real-attempt profile, including setup-only aborted attempts. Binding a target is not proof of actual participation; a code-exercised correspondence flag remains a qualified candidate. Equal inputs/timestamps do not identify events, and graph replay is not a newly observed occurrence.
decisions.limit: Unknown end/planned runs are outside this admission profile, not absent from reality. No full UFO-B causality or new ROoST equivalence is asserted.
